svg.title: A hash, not a sequence
svg.desc: Three scatter plots of consecutive random pairs. One LCG step seeded by the index puts every pair on a few straight lines and reaches 128 of 4,096 cells. The sine hash past 2^24 repeats inputs, correlating neighbours at 0.50, and has only 4,179 distinct values from 65,536. PCG fills the square uniformly with correlation -0.0019.
svg.text: Each dot is a spark's first two draws, (u(2i), u(2i+1)), for 2,048 consecutive particles.
one LCG step, seeded by i
And the sine hash is not one function: evaluated by the GPU, 480,168 of 1,048,576 outputs differ from C++'s. PCG: all 1,048,576 identical.
